title: Capacity planning and nonfunctional service objectives
workflow: Gather branch, channel, month-end and seasonal customer operation volumes
Define minimum service availability and business transaction safety objectives
Create isolated synthetic load fixtures with realistic account distributions
Measure response, queue lag, database locks and ledger reconciliation under load
Model safe throttling, graceful degradation and retry behavior
Approve capacity envelope only using reproducible measured evidence
invariants: Marketing TPS target is not a validated performance result
Correctness of journal and event idempotency is non-negotiable at peak load
Rate limiting must not lose accepted banking instructions
Do not mark a settlement backlog cleared without independent source reconciliation
Cross-institution contention and noisy-neighbor interference must be measured
Resource changes remain traceable through change control
Latency targets are bounded by approved institution risk appetites
acceptance_tests: Concurrent posting requests preserve balance integrity
Capacity rejection exposes explicit retry-safe state
Large backlogs recover without duplicate journal entries
Resource exhaustion cannot expose another institution's records
Reconciliation window honored under tested peak scenario
independent_gate: Operations/CFO signed workload assumptions, executed tests and independent performance acceptance.
